inlines.v: CUCULLATE, CUCULLATED adjective [Latin , a hood, a cowl.] 1. Hooded; cowled; covered as with a hood. 2. Having the shape or resemblance of a hood; or wide at the top and drawn to a point below, in shape of a conical roll of paper; as a cucullate leaf.
